assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. A single isolated, shallow dry wooded ravine ground patch for a realistic American Civil War overhead strategy game, Cold Harbor Virginia June 1864. An irregular oblong patch, aspect 2.5 to 1, with a gently winding shallow eroded gully crossing it from left to right, uneven crumbly clay banks, small broken clods and roots, sparse low faded olive grass around its feathered edges. Clearly broken difficult footing, not a deep canyon, river, shell crater, trench or rock quarry. No trees rising above ground. The depression has shadowed soil and low sloping sides, no black chasm. Orthographic overhead view looking almost straight down, 70 degrees below horizontal, no perspective vanishing point. Realistically textured miniature battlefield terrain in muted Virginia brown earth, dry olive grass, gray wood, soft neutral midday lighting from upper left. Single isolated terrain cutout centered with 8 percent transparent margins, actual transparent alpha background outside the ragged natural ground edge. No backdrop, checkerboard, text, border, people, blood, flags, weapons, modern materials, buildings or horizon. Fine detail but strong readable silhouette at small game scale. PNG RGBA asset.
